scope: Targeted property tests verifying the monotonicity of the relational Chase algorithm under functional dependency and candidate key lattice extensions (F1 ⊆ F2 => chase(F1, J) => chase(F2, J)) across random small relational schemas

properties_verified.details: Verified 100 randomized trials across schemas with 3-6 attributes, 1-4 keys, 0-4 FDs, and 2-4 components: 0 violations of F1 ⊆ F2 => (chase(F1, J) => chase(F2, J)), with both active implication and strict promotion states verified.
Verified that strictly expanding candidate key sets K1 ⊂ K2 ⊂ K3 monotonically preserves and promotes join dependency satisfaction.
Verified that prefix extensions of transitive dependency cascades monotonically propagate symbol unification across the tableau.
Verified on Darwen-Date-Fagin Theorem 6.1 ternary join: the unimplied chase state under pairwise keys {AB, BC, AC} is strictly promoted to implied upon adding determinant A -> B.
Verified that under empty dependencies F = ∅, the chase refutes non-trivial join dependencies and admits only trivial components.
